title_suffix: repairable worker reports and legacy review recovery
summary: OSpec 1.8.19 makes canonical same-task worker reports reviewable and repairable evidence, and safely refreshes legacy task reviews whose findings could not be bound to older snapshots.
new: Added an automatic fresh-review recovery route for legacy task reviews whose findings target an unbound canonical worker report.
improved: Fresh task reviews now snapshot the exact canonical worker report alongside declared task targets so later report corrections remain evidence-bound.
Legacy recovery preserves historical review artifacts and repair-round accounting while issuing a normal controller-owned review action.
fixed: Fixed same-task worker-report findings being rejected as outside completed task targets during task repair.
Fixed worker-report changes after review remaining invisible to review freshness validation.
Kept other tasks' reports, report directories, and arbitrary controller artifacts outside legal repair scope.
docs: Documented canonical worker-report evidence binding, legacy Goal recovery, repair-scope boundaries, and the confirmed Web task-9 failure mode.
